usedFor: Shopify holds paid orders, and RemOnline receives a lead through “Create a Lead” each time “Order Paid” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create a Lead” in RemOnline
bestTemplate.why: A paid order is a confirmed customer, so the action records them as a lead to follow up.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so “Change Order Status” built on it runs after a scheduled check.
